answer: When the comet crosses, the registry opens its inlet for ninety seconds, announced ten seconds ahead: each applicant floats one timber log through, steered by a live pilot, and the k-th identity from one household rides a raft of k logs, needing k pilots steering at the same instant. A pilot steers one log only; the warden counts the logs at the far bank and stamps each, and a pilot caught steering two logs burns both identities. So 1,000 puppets need 1+2+…+1000 = 500,500 pilot-crossings at $20 each, $10,010,000; one honest user pays one pilot $20 for one log.
